description: DEX swap interface with token pair selection, slippage settings, and liquidity pool cards.

integrations: DEX aggregator API for quotes and routing
architectureNotes: SwapCard handles token pair input with direction toggle and slippage configuration.
TokenSelectDialog provides searchable token list with popular token shortcuts.
PoolCard displays liquidity position details with add/remove actions.
Wire swap execution to your DEX router contract or aggregator API.
